english: Wandering Jew (Pakia); also Benghal dayflower, tropical spiderwort
other_mijikenda: Duruma: same name (Pakia App. VI, given there for Commelina bracteosa)

teaser.en: A creeping weed with sky-blue flowers that open for a morning, then hide away in a folded green hood.
teaser.sw: Gugu linalotambaa lenye maua ya buluu kama anga, yanayofunguka kwa asubuhi moja tu kisha kujificha ndani ya kofia ya kijani iliyokunjwa.
teaser.dg: Kpwekpwe inayoambala yenye maruwa ga samawati, ganayovuguka ligundzu mwenga tu, chisha ganadzifwitsa ndani ya kodza dide ra chijani ririrokundzwa.

summary.en: Dzedza is a creeping dayflower with fleshy stems and small blue flowers, common in fields and disturbed ground. Digo people class it with the soft herbs and grasses, not with the climbers, because its stem never becomes woody.
summary.sw: Dzedza ni mmea unaotambaa wenye mashina manono na maua madogo ya buluu, unaopatikana sana mashambani na kwenye ardhi iliyovurugwa. Wadigo huuweka pamoja na mimea laini na majani ya nyasi, si pamoja na mitambaa, kwa sababu shina lake halibadiliki kuwa la mti.
summary.dg: *Dzedza* ni mmea unaoambala photsi wa jenasi ya *Commelina* (*dayflower*), wenye mihi yenye madzi manji na maruwa madide ga samawati, unaophahikana sana mindani na phatu ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa. Adigo anauika phamwenga na mimea laini na nyasi, si phamwenga na mbugu, kpwa sababu muhiwe taukala mgumu dza wa muhi.

about.en: Dzedza is a low, sprawling herb whose soft, fleshy stems trail along the ground and root where they touch it. The oval leaves have sheathing bases, often fringed with reddish hairs. The flowers come out of a small folded green bract shaped like a funnel. Each has two rounded sky-blue petals and a third, much smaller one, and opens for only a few hours. The plant can also flower and set seed underground, which helps make it a stubborn weed.
about.sw: Dzedza ni mmea mdogo unaotanda chini, ambao mashina yake laini na manono hutambaa ardhini na kutoa mizizi pale yanapogusa udongo. Majani yake ya umbo la yai yana vitako vinavyozunguka shina, mara nyingi vyenye pindo la manyoya mekundu. Maua hutoka ndani ya kibrakti kidogo cha kijani kilichokunjwa kama faneli. Kila ua lina petali mbili za mviringo za buluu kama anga na ya tatu ndogo zaidi, na hufunguka kwa saa chache tu. Mmea huu pia unaweza kuchanua na kuzaa mbegu chini ya ardhi, jambo linalouwezesha kuwa gugu sugu.
about.dg: *Dzedza* ni mmea laini wa photsi unaoenea, ambao mihiye laini yenye madzi inaambala photsi na kumera mizi phatu inaphoguta tsi. Makodzage ni ga mviringo, na photsi ya chila kodza inazunguluka muhi dza mfuko, mara nyinji ichikala na nyere za kundu chidide kanda-kanda. Maruwa ganatuluka ndani ya kodza dide ra chijani ririrokundzwa, renye umbo dza ra chifumbu. Chila ruwa rina makodza mairi ga ruwa ga mviringo ga samawati, na ra hahu dide sana, na rinavuguka kpwa saa chache tu. Mmea uhu piya unaweza kutuluza maruwa na tembe tsini ya tsi, na hiri rinauhenda ukale kpwekpwe ngumu kuiusa.

where.en: It grows in cultivated fields, gardens, roadsides and other disturbed ground. It spreads in the rains, and pieces of stem left after weeding often take root again.
where.sw: Hukua mashambani, bustanini, kando ya barabara na kwenye ardhi nyingine iliyovurugwa. Huenea wakati wa mvua, na vipande vya shina vinavyobaki baada ya kupalilia mara nyingi huota mizizi tena.
where.dg: Unamera mindani, busitanini, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu phanjina ambapho tsi ikatsimbwa au kubanangwa. Unaenea wakati wa mvula, na vipande vya muhi vinavyosala bada ya kuusa kpwekpwe mara nyinji vinamera mizi tsona.

uses.en: Pakia records no use for it among the Digo. Elsewhere in tropical Africa and Asia the young leaves are cooked as a vegetable and the plant is cut for livestock fodder.
uses.sw: Pakia haripoti matumizi yoyote miongoni mwa Wadigo. Kwingineko katika Afrika na Asia ya kitropiki, majani machanga hupikwa kama mboga na mmea hukatwa kuwa lishe ya mifugo.
uses.dg: Pakia kaandika kukala Adigo anauhumira kpwa chitu chochosi. Kpwenye tsi zanjina za dzoho za Afrika na Asia, makodza malaini nkujitwa dza mboga, na mmea nkukatwa kuhenda chakurya cha mifugo.

culture.en: Pakia uses *Commelina benghalensis* to show where the Digo draw the line between life forms. Although it trails and scrambles, it is not *mbugu*, a climber, because a climber must have a woody stem. Instead it belongs with *nyasi*, the herbaceous layer of grasses, herbs and creepers.
culture.sw: Pakia anatumia *Commelina benghalensis* kuonyesha mahali Wadigo wanapoweka mpaka kati ya maumbo ya mimea. Ingawa hutambaa na kujivuta juu ya mimea mingine, si *mbugu*, yaani mtambaa, kwa sababu mtambaa lazima uwe na shina la mti. Badala yake ni wa kundi la *nyasi*, tabaka la chini la majani ya nyasi, mimea midogo laini na mimea inayotambaa.
culture.dg: Pakia anahumira *Commelina benghalensis* kuonyesa vira Adigo anavyoganya mimea kpwa mafungu kulengana na umbo rao. Hata kala unaambala na kukpwera, si *mbugu*, mmea unaokpwera, kpwa sababu libugu ni lazima rikale na muhi wa nyama za muhi. Badalaye, ni wa *nyasi*, fungu ra mimea laini ya photsi: nyasi, mimea midide laini na mimea inayoambala.

names.en: Digo: *dzedza*. Pakia's list gives the English name Wandering Jew; botanists also call it Benghal dayflower or tropical spiderwort. Pakia's name lists are not consistent. Appendix III gives *dzedza* for *C. benghalensis* and *chidzedza* for its larger-flowered relative *C. bracteosa*, but Appendix VI pairs *dzedza* with *C. bracteosa* and says the name is shared with Duruma and Swahili.
names.sw: Kidigo: *dzedza*. Orodha ya Pakia inatoa jina la Kiingereza *Wandering Jew*; wataalamu wa mimea pia huuita *Benghal dayflower* au *tropical spiderwort*. Orodha za majina za Pakia hazilingani. Kiambatisho III kinatoa *dzedza* kwa *C. benghalensis* na *chidzedza* kwa ndugu yake mwenye maua makubwa zaidi, *C. bracteosa*, lakini Kiambatisho VI kinaunganisha *dzedza* na *C. bracteosa* na kusema jina hilo linashirikiwa na Kiduruma na Kiswahili.
names.dg: Chidigo: *dzedza*. Madzina ga Pakia ganalavya dzina ra Chingereza *Wandering Jew*; asayansi piya anauiha *Benghal dayflower* au *tropical spiderwort*. Madzina ga Pakia tagalengana. *Appendix III* inalavya *dzedza* kpwa *C. benghalensis* na *chidzedza* kpwa nduguye mwenye maruwa makulu, *C. bracteosa*, ela *Appendix VI* inaika *dzedza* phamwenga na *C. bracteosa* na inagomba kukala dzina hiri ni sawa kpwa Chiduruma na Chiswahili.

reason.en: Chidzedza, the closely related Commelina bracteosa
reason.sw: Chidzedza, yaani Commelina bracteosa, ndugu yake wa karibu

reason.dg: Kpwekpwe yanjina laini inayoambala mindani na busitanini
